APPLE IPHONE & IPAD

Add it with Safari.

  1. Open this page in Safari.
  2. Tap Share. On some versions, open the More menu first.
  3. Choose Add to Home Screen. Scroll through the actions if needed.
  4. If shown, turn on Open as Web App, then tap Add.

Look for the maroon-and-gold 90R Watch icon on your home screen.

SAMSUNG GALAXY & ANDROID

Use Chrome or Samsung Internet.

  1. Open this page in Chrome or Samsung Internet.
  2. If the Install 90R app button appears above, tap it and confirm.
  3. In Chrome, you can also open the menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
  4. In Samsung Internet, use its install icon near the address bar, or the menu’s home-screen option, then confirm.

Menu wording varies by browser version. Open the link in your browser if you arrived through LinkedIn, Facebook, or another app.

The same tracker. A simpler way to open it.

Daily published updates

The website’s daily bill checks feed this app. Connect to the internet and refresh to load the latest published snapshot. The app does not need a separate subscription.

Saved content when offline

After an online visit finishes preparing the app, the saved tracker can open without a connection. A notice identifies saved content. Check its snapshot date; official bill records and hearing links need an internet connection.

Your watchlist stays yours

Saved bills and notes stay on your device. Browser and installed-app storage may differ, and they do not sync across phones. Use Sources → Download personal backup, then restore that backup in the app if you need to transfer them.

Use the mobile website anytime

Installation is optional. The full mobile website ↗ includes news, hearings, and court rulings alongside the tracker. This app stays focused on the 90th Regular Session.

This is an installable web app, distributed directly from this website. No Apple App Store, Google Play, or Galaxy Store listing is required. It does not send push notifications.
